name: Shopify
notes: Card fill proven on 7/7 stores in the 2026-06 campaign; completed purchases were stopped by issuer 3DS step-up, not by the recipe.

steps.addToCart: Resolve the variant from <product-path>.js and hit the /cart/<variantId>:1 permalink (bypasses TYDAL/Klaviyo popups that no-op the AJAX add), then /cart and 'Check out'. Fallback: button[name=add]. Never substitute a different variant than the URL's ?variant=.
steps.payment: Split iframes named card-fields-<field>-<rand>. Target by iframe[name*=card-fields-number]/-expiry/-verification/-name via frameLocator. Fill expiry and name first, the card-number token, then the CVV token immediately after into the verification frame.

gotchas: Only the PLURAL /checkouts/ path is Shopify's; singular /checkout/ is WooCommerce and others.
Shopify checkouts commonly trigger issuer 3DS on first automated card use — expect CHALLENGE:three_ds and hand off.
